findings.summary: Use the shared type-only import/re-export classifier.
Route discarded listener-option values through the shared emitter.
Share the UTF-8 replacement decoder with URLSearchParams.
Use icu_string for the language-tag buffer protocol.
Build/run the border-image fixture through runRmlUiFixture.
Reuse pinArgument for Promise.all/race input snapshots.
Use the existing symbol-level default-library classifier for Date, DateTimeFormat and ArrayBufferView.
Use the shared C++ string literal formatter for emitted record keys.
Share the three detached listener value pins.
Share the Math min/max native call spelling.
Implement JsonValue::some through its existing every traversal.
Share the duplicated disabled-control activation check.
Use the existing ASCII string-lower helper for removed attribute names.
Layer.first_draw duplicates the draw count already captured by Layer.checkpoint.
The flex-only stretch block still contains unreachable grid alternatives.
bindParameter duplicates array-binding omission, identifier validation, and rest handling in two loops.
The JSON nullish-coalescing branch copies the lazy fallback implementation already defined later in the same method.
Image readiness retains decoded pixels that no readiness consumer uses.
Object.values and object spread repeat a linear lookup for every parsed object key.
RegExp.match builds replacement callback packets and unused capture strings for every match.
Structured-clone field ordering uses a growing array as its visited set.
Move the persisted field optionality into the shared property reader and remove the spelling-based equality fallback.
